description: PAVEMENT_MESSAGES is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. This dataset is an inventory of Pavement Messages on Hawaii Highways. Information available include: location of pavement messages, condition, color intensity of the messages, if the messages are weathered./worn, if the messages are mispainted. Coverage: Hawaii. The portal files it under the category Roadside Data. Its tags are row, pfes, barriers. The table has 36 columns. The portal shows 2024-07-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
